title: OfficeJoy 6-Foot White Pencil Christmas Tree

comparisons.notes: Costway MS2J-3611 6 ft unlit white pencil tree, matched to the OfficeJoy by photo and specs (340 tips, 2.4 ft base, folding metal stand), not UPC; live page showed $72.98 with no out-of-stock notice.

writeup: This OfficeJoy 6-foot white pencil tree is unlit, with 340 branch tips, a slim footprint of about 29 inches and a folding metal X stand, so it fits narrow corners and entryways. Woot has it brand new for $19.99, while Home Depot sells the same-spec Costway version for $72.98. Stock is thin, with only a few left and a limit of three per customer.
amazon_match_notes: Verified exact match by checker: OfficeJoy GT-00521LB, UPC 608564968905.
